lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the primary high-luminance blobs, forming a series of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting sharp vertical pixel gradients with high-intensity light on the superior edge and lower-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distinct high-luminance blobs are distributed across the visible surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast pixel clusters (ectoparasites or remoras) located ventral to the pectoral fin and near the ventral midline.
